The '''sniper droideka''' or '''droideka sniper''', more commonly known as the '''sniper droid''', was a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] variation of [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Their shields are too strong.|Ahsoka Tano shouting while being fired upon by a Droideka Sharpshooter|<ref name="Kidnapped" />}}
[[File:SniperDroidekaFreecoBike-GAW.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A sniper droid fires on a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] in a [[CK-6 swoop bike/Legends|CK-6 swoop]].]]
Designed for urban warfare in a city where the droid could easily conceal itself, the sniper droideka was equipped with a single heavy [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] rather than paired dual blaster cannons seen on standard droideka models; neither was it equipped with a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]]. Instead, the rounded plate that served as their rolling surface was able to fold down over their face with a small slot that they could aim and fire through. The plate was armored and was resistant to blaster fire, however, the plate only protected their front and left their sides vulnerable. Their rate of fire was also slower, but provided much more penetrating power. They were designed with a highly advanced targeting computer and were extremely accurate. They were capable of speaking in both [[Binary/Legends|binary]] and [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]].<ref name="GAW" />

==History==
{{Quote|Ahsoka, they're weak from the side. I got an angle on your droid.<br>Ok, I got a view of yours too. Same time, ready? <br> Go!|Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano on taking down the sharpshooters|<ref name="Kidnapped" />}}
A pair of such droids were used during the [[Battle of Kiros]]. They were used to defend a bomb from enemies, these being [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. Initially, the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] attempted to deflect their weapon fire back at the droids but their front sections were armored to protect them from such an attack. However, [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] Skywalker determined that the droids lack such protection on their sides which saw him and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] deflect the sniper droid fire at their sides thus destroying them.<ref name="Kidnapped">{{TCW|Kidnapped}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Sniper droidekas appear in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' series.

===Non-canon history===
They appear in the ''[[LEGO Star Wars Movie Short]]'' series.

Sniper Droids also were used during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]] and were equipped with a bubble shield.
